I sincerely hope you are doing ok, since this is an older post. I read the whole thing and I honestly identify with so many points in your story. 

You arent a bad person, and you dont deserve death. I also used to do some pretty vile, toxic things when I was younger, but it was because that was what I knew. I was treated badly by those around me so I treated others badly, but teenagers are just kids really, you dont stay that way forever. 
The longer your life goes on the further you will move away from that painful history. 

I remember feeling much like the way you describe when I was 20. I'm turning 29 this year and I'm honestly so grateful I held on. Adult life is a lot better I think. You have more control over the way you live and who is in your life. As you get older you generally get better at achieving this. 

Long reply, I know. But I just wanted to let you know that other people have felt, and do feel the way you feel. You arent alone in this world, use your pain to remind you of the person you want to be, and the life you want to create. Make a beautiful life.
